text:
AMAZING SERVICE!
I have visited this Vet on two occasions,  once with my cat and then with two dogs. Her treatment and handling of my pets is outstanding.  She is always polite and  greets with a smile. Price is very fair. Even outside of her working hours, she replied to my messages on Line and gave me information about 24hour clinic for emergency.  On other occasions I have received message with links to medication for me to buy online. Very impressive clinic, she certainly has a love for animals.
